items.stem: What is a POCO in Synnduit?

options.text: The C# class that describes one entity type, decorated with attributes
The connector that reads the source

items.explanation: A POCO is a plain C# class for one entity type (Staff, Student, School); its attributes form the contract with the engine.

misconceptions.c: That's the feed (IFeed); the POCO is the data class the feed returns.

items.stem: Match each POCO attribute to its job. Which set of pairings is entirely correct?

options.text: [EntityType] → GUID identity of the entity type · [SourceSystemIdentifier] → source-side ID for the mapping · [EntityProperty] → field tracked for change detection · [DuplicationKey] → matches a new record to an existing one during dedup
[EntityType] → GUID identity · [SourceSystemIdentifier] → matches a new record during dedup · [EntityProperty] → tracked for change detection · [DuplicationKey] → source-side ID for the mapping
[EntityType] → field tracked for change detection · [SourceSystemIdentifier] → source-side ID · [EntityProperty] → GUID identity · [DuplicationKey] → dedup matching
[EntityType] → GUID identity · [SourceSystemIdentifier] → tracked for change detection · [EntityProperty] → source-side ID for the mapping · [DuplicationKey] → dedup matching

items.explanation: [EntityType] = GUID identity, [SourceSystemIdentifier] = source-side ID for the mapping, [EntityProperty] = tracked for change detection, [DuplicationKey] = dedup matching.

misconceptions.b: This swaps the two most-confused attributes: [SourceSystemIdentifier] marks the source-side ID for the mapping, while [DuplicationKey] is the dedup key.
misconceptions.d: [SourceSystemIdentifier] is the source-side ID; [EntityProperty] is the change-tracking marker — they're swapped here.

items.stem: You add a property to a POCO but forget to put [EntityProperty] on it. What happens?

options.text: The field is not tracked for change detection — changes to it won't be picked up
It becomes the duplication key automatically

items.explanation: [EntityProperty] is what tells the engine to track a field for change detection; without it, the field's changes are invisible to the diff.

misconceptions.a: Attributes are runtime metadata; omitting one is not a compile error — which is what makes this bug subtle.

items.stem: Which attribute marks the property the engine uses to match a 'new' source record to a possible existing destination record during deduplication?
items.explanation: [DuplicationKey] designates the field(s) used to detect duplicates (e.g. EmployeeId on Staff).

misconceptions.a: [DestinationSystemIdentifier] marks the destination-side ID for the mapping, not the dedup key.

items.stem: Which pair of attributes is what makes a mapping (L1.6) possible for an entity?
items.explanation: A mapping links a source ID to a destination ID; the source/destination identifier attributes are what tell the engine which properties those are.

misconceptions.a: These drive change detection and dedup, not the mapping link itself.
